description: SBT↔SBT internal purchase record. Per ADR-2605192115 §3 (SBT internal carve-out), purchases between two Adherent SBT holders within the religious-corp boundary are permitted — distinct from external commerce, which is prohibited. This Lexicon records the AT Protocol counterpart of the on-chain internal transfer. Both parties must hold an Adherent SBT at the moment of the transaction (verified by the InternalCommerce contract on Base L2). Allowed scope: religious goods, services rendered between adherents (e.g., translation work, hospitality), consensual support arrangements. NOT for: external SaaS sales, subscriptions to non-adherents, advertising-supported commerce. Tithe DOES NOT apply (the carveout's purpose is intra-organism commerce; the 10% tithe is for external donations only).

buyerDid.description: DID of the buyer. Must hold an Adherent SBT at txHash block.

sellerDid.description: DID of the seller. Must hold an Adherent SBT at txHash block.

amountMicros.description: Purchase amount in currency micros (6 decimal places for USDC). Integer-with-implied-units per ADR-2605190900. Minimum 1 to prevent dust-spam.

currency.description: Settlement currency. Currently only USDC is supported (per ADR-2605172100 — no fiat processors). Future expansion via Council ratification.

itemDescription.description: Free-form markdown description of what was purchased. Both parties' SBT identity is on-chain; the description records the substantive content of the exchange.

itemCategory.description: Optional category for analytics. Religious-corp-appropriate categories only.

txHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the InternalCommerce contract call. Prefix `0x`, lowercase.

noteRef.description: Optional AT URI of an `com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record` wrapping a private note (receipt, terms, agreement details) between buyer and seller.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment of internal purchase.
